beats.name: Arrival at the Nordschleife paddock (midday)
beats.pressure: The world expects them **on site, introduced, and professionally present** before any lap. Motion-sickness aftercare should not erase the Industry Pool frame.

beats.name: The Green Hell (afternoon)
beats.pressure: The day expects **real track time and live telemetry**.

beats.name: Adrenaline crash and debrief (late afternoon)
beats.pressure: The world is ready for **return → telemetry debrief → grounding**. Whether the aero "proves" the simulation is open. Aftercare is available pressure, not a scripted monologue.

beats.name: Transition toward recovery and Affalterbach runway (evening)
beats.pressure: The world is ready to **leave the circuit and set the stage for Affalterbach** when the scene is done with the track. Do not force hotel check-in mid-stint.
